prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: a single fine-line architectural illustration for the heritage collection 访古.
Image 1 is the STYLE MASTER, an existing Vairocana Buddha contour drawing: use ONLY its elegant delicate slightly organic thin black contours, restrained structural detail and extensive white space.
Image 2 is the frontal SUBJECT GEOMETRY reference: the 1633 MAIN HALL (Hondo) and projecting Kiyomizu Stage of Kiyomizu-dera in KYOTO, JAPAN. Image 3 is a close-up geometry reference for the tall wooden support frame under this same stage. Image 4 is another actual photograph for the main hall roof and stage proportions.
Draw ONLY the complete MAIN HALL and the ENTIRE projecting wooden stage, including the supporting pillars and horizontal nuki rails down to their separate stone feet on the sloping terrain. Use the almost straight-on southern facade from image 2. Retain the very large curved hipped roof, horizontal ridge, smooth Japanese cypress-bark roof surface, and the TWO small triangular ornamental gables at the left and right ends of the front facade. Do not invent a third central gable. Below the roof retain the open timber hall facade, projecting rectangular central stage and its simple low balustrade. The stage stands about 13m above the slope and is supported by a deep rectilinear timber grid: long vertical unbroken zelkova posts joined by multiple levels of horizontal through-rails. Image 3 shows how the rails penetrate the posts and project slightly beyond them. This tall grid is a defining feature; draw its full height, make it clearly legible. Keep the realistic stage width versus roof width shown in the photo; the stage is centered, with flanking hall verandas behind it. Preserve the structural rhythm and the uneven sloping footings; do not turn the bottom into a broad masonry plinth or a generic palace stair.
Style: sparse fine BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. Surfaces and all structural voids stay WHITE, including the roof and hall interior. Use confident thin contour lines and a few finer inner lines. Absolutely no black fills, gray shading, hatch, pencil grain, wood texture or gradients. Roof is a broad quiet white shape with only edge contours; no tile grid, no dense repeated roof-surface strokes. Simplify tiny carvings and balustrade repetition. Match image 1 line weight and airiness.
Composition: landscape 1536x1024, near-frontal with verticals vertical, whole building approximately 82% of image width, full roof ridge, eave corners and ALL lower wooden support feet completely inside the frame. Generous white margin on every side. Remove the trees and foreground foliage to reveal the reference-supported structural grid. Remove tourists, curtains with writing, signs, neighboring buildings, other temple halls and ALL PAGODAS. No three-storey pagoda. Only a few short ground lines indicating the slope. No labels, lettering, calligraphy, dimensions, captions, watermark, frame or border.

site_recommendation.lede: 清水寺本堂以宽大的桧皮屋顶覆在音羽山坡上，檐前的清水舞台向崖外伸出。舞台下成列的高木柱与横贯木交织，显露出日本悬造建筑的支撑方式。
facts: 寺院始建于778年；图中现存本堂与舞台重建于1633年，按江户时代登记。
本堂为桧皮葺寄栋造，南面两侧的小破风与中央伸出的舞台构成主要轮廓。
清水舞台距地面近13米，由18根榉木柱与横贯木连接支撑，原用于向观音奉献艺能表演。

quality_check.notes: 本堂宽大主屋顶、左右两处小破风、中央舞台及下部横竖木架、柱脚均完整；无三重塔、游客与文字；白色屋面留白。
